title: Barn Rat Spot
info: Great spot to lay down and wait for players to loot the barn that sits next to Stables. If you position yourself right, you can look directly into the barn. When players loot the vertical weapon crate leaning against the wood, you have a very clear and easy kill.

title: Barn Rat Spot
info: Sitting right next to the broken part of the fence allows you to look directly into the second floor bathroom of Motel. Great spot for audio cues/picking off players.

title: Barn Rat Spot
info: Awesome sniping spot if you arrive first at Motel. Jump up onto the truck and lay down/crouch at the sand bags. You can direct your aim towards Wheatfield Farmhouse/Villa and you will almost always catch a player running to Motel with their knife out.
